title: The basics
description: Moving around, making files and folders, copying, renaming, searching and deleting.

exercises.task: List what's in this folder (it's empty, and that's fine).
Create an empty file called todo.txt.
Write the words buy milk into todo.txt.
exercises.hint: echo prints text, and > sends it into a file instead of the screen: echo "some text" > <file>
cat <file> prints a file to the screen.

exercises.task: Go back up to the folder above this one.
Copy notes/todo.txt to a new file here called backup.txt.

exercises.hint: mv moves files, and moving to a new name renames: mv <old> <new>

exercises.task: Find every file ending in .txt, in this folder and the ones inside it.
exercises.hint: find <where> -name <pattern>. Put the pattern in quotes: "*.txt"

exercises.task: Search notes/todo.txt for the word milk.
exercises.hint: grep <word> <file> prints the lines that contain the word.
rm <file> deletes it. There's no Trash with rm, so it's gone for good.

exercises.task: Delete the notes folder and everything in it.
exercises.hint: rm needs -r (recursive) to delete a folder. I'll ask you to confirm: that's the point.

done: You just used pwd, ls, mkdir, cd, touch, echo, cat, cp, mv, find, grep and rm.
